initialization: Frozen original FMP-v1 per-category 40-epoch weights; new random decoder; no U2/LF1/OGD weights

architecture.feature: 48-channel frozen pixels pooled to80x112; cross-attention memory40x56
architecture.queries: 64 confidence-ordered FMP candidates, padded, plus64 free8x8 spatial queries; no expected counts or task rules
architecture.decoder: 2 Transformer decoder layers, width64,4 heads; joint class/no-object,mask,center,box,unordered axis heads
architecture.plain_set: same dimensions, ordinary spatial attention and supervised object/mask/geometry losses
architecture.evidence_edit: predicted-mask feedback into second cross-attention; mask-geometry consistency; paired-edit count and center-change consistency; duplicate query perturbations
architecture.limitations: ordinary set matching and mask attention are established techniques; combined mechanism is experimental, not claimed novel or successful before validation

training.supervision: existing normal-source component labels and weak masks; one deterministic add/remove/move edit per parent, inherited roles and updated factual targets; edited arrangements can be anomalous; no binary anomaly loss
training.loss: classCE(no-object weight.2)+2 centerL1+2 boxL1+3 symmetric axisL1+maskBCE/Dice; full additionally.25 geometry-binding+.25 edit-consistency
training.budget: 40 original FMP epochs plus768 decoder updates/1536 image exposures per category and variant; 30 independently trained heads; cycles are not original FMP epochs

selection.objective: .8 macro class pointF1(center distance<.08)+.2 macro class support-mask Dice on normal DEV originals and deterministic same-parent edits
selection.readout: class argmax including no-object; mask sigmoid>.5 for evidence; no test threshold/model/variant selection
selection.fallback: none: both preregistered decoder variants evaluated even if inferior

evaluation.normal_reference: same TRAINq1/q99 interval and DEVpadding formula; same empirical tail and max+.01sum
evaluation.calibration: same held-out normal CAL,p95(higher),strict score>threshold,per deployment task
evaluation.appearance_and_OCR: same frozen FMP semantic masks, original attribute extractors and cached OCR; no new appearance classifier or VLM calls
evaluation.original_method: FMP-v1+ZL1 cached predictions; no baseline retraining
evaluation.publication: separate report only; original official tables and manuscript untouched
evaluation.public_test_limit: public tests and known cases used in earlier development; not blind evaluation
evaluation.annotation_limit: VID supervision and masks include proxy/weak labels; no new precise instance or axis ground truth claimed
